name: cf-cdn-ir-chunk-validator
description: Validates a single domain's accumulator IR YAML file at ir/accumulator/{hostname}.yaml for structural correctness. Performs 8 checks: path_pattern and precedence field presence/types, origin.domain validity, viewer_request_ops entry integrity, non_convertible reason strings, duplicate precedence detection, viewer_request_ops type ordering, hostname-filename consistency, and KVS redirect requirement cross-check. Outputs a per-domain JSON validation report. Must be invoked once per domain (parallelizable).
